meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you want **men’s formal shirts in India**, I’d shortlist these brands rather than buying purely by price:

| Brand | Best for | Typical sweet spot |
|---|---|---:|
| **Van Heusen** | ⭐ Best overall / everyday office | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, polished corporate look | ₹1,500–₹3,000 |
| **Arrow** | Crisp, classic formal styling | ₹1,200–₹2,500 |
| **Raymond** | Classic quality & comfortable fabrics | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |
| **Park Avenue** | Good value for regular office wear | ₹900–₹2,000 |
| **Peter England** | Budget-friendly rotation | ₹700–₹1,500 |
| **Blackberrys** | Modern, sharper fits | ₹1,200–₹2,500 |


Recent 2026 comparisons consistently put Van Heusen, Arrow, Louis Philippe, Raymond and Park Avenue among the stronger Indian formalwear options. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

**🥇 Van Heusen** — If you're buying 5–7 shirts for regular office use, this would be my first choice. It has a particularly good balance of fit, fabric, availability and price. Current listings also show solid formal shirts around ₹1,000–₹1,300 during discounts. [barkhaboutique.com](https://barkhaboutique.com/compare/marks-spencer-vs-van-heusen-vs-arrow-formal?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Van Heusen Men Solid Slim Fit Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,029*

**🥈 Louis Philippe** — Spend a little more if you want the shirt to look noticeably more premium, especially for client meetings, presentations and senior/corporate environments.

### [Louis Philippe Men Formal Shirt]()
*₹1,469*

**🥉 Raymond** — Excellent choice if you prefer a more traditional, understated formal appearance.

### [Raymond Men's Slim Fit Solid Formal Shirt]()
*₹986*

### If I were building your wardrobe

I'd buy:
- **2 white** shirts
- **2 light blue** shirts
- **1 light grey**
- **1 subtle blue/white stripe**
- **1 pale pink or lavender**, if your workplace allows it

Prefer **100% cotton or cotton-rich fabric** for comfort in India; wrinkle-resistant blends can be useful if you travel frequently. Fit matters more than the brand—shoulder seams should sit at your shoulder edge, and the shirt shouldn't pull across the chest. [dressingschool.com](https://dressingschool.com/picks/formal-shirts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**If you tell me your budget per shirt (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / ₹2,500 / ₹4,000) and whether you want slim, regular, or relaxed fit, I can pick the 5 best shirts to buy right now.**
